lines.text: AI writes code faster than ever.
According to DORA 2025 and 2026, it speeds up delivery, but also increases instability.
Kaizen is the engine around Addy Osmani's agent skills.
lines.caption: Kaizen is the engine around Addy Osmani's agent-skills.

lines.text: Everything starts from a quality bar: constraints, each enforced by a check that runs.
The spec defines what to build. The plan decides how.
Small tasks, each with its test and its verification. Past lessons come back by themselves.
As soon as code changes, a quality gate keeps the turn open while tests are red.
The five-axis review records itself, and without a review, nothing is pushed.
Ship runs the launch checklist, then the pull request is followed until it is ready.
lines.caption: Ship runs the launch checklist, then the PR is followed until it is ready.

lines.text: Merging and going to production stay in your hands.
Finally, durable lessons are captured, and come back by themselves next cycle.
The goal: every unit of work makes the next one easier.
Kaizen and agent skills. For Claude Code.
lines.caption: Kaizen and agent-skills. For Claude Code.
